sources.title: AdamW Optimizer (optimizer.py) | cmu-l3/anlp-fall2025-hw1 | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: The AdamW implementation in this repository provides a custom optimizer based on the Adam algorithm with decoupled weight decay, as proposed by Loshchilov & Hutter in 2017. It is designed to handle the fine-tuning of the Llama2-based models for classification tasks and LoRA adaptation.
